name: UN WUP 2018
desc: The classic UN list: each country's own definition of a city (city proper, urban agglomeration or metropolitan area). Populations are the 2018 revision's projection for 2025.
source: UN DESA, World Urbanization Prospects: The 2018 Revision (urban agglomerations ≥ 300,000); names: GeoNames

cities.name: Tokyo
cities.note: Major Metropolitan areas (M.M.A.) are defined by the Statistics Bureau of Japan. Census figures for 2005, 2010 and 2015 refer to the Kanto M.M.A.; figures from 1990 to 2000 are based on the Keihinyo M.M.A., and figures from 1960 to 1985 are based on the Keihin M.M.A. As a reference, the population of Tokyo-to was estimated at 12.1 million persons and of the Tokyo Ku-area at 8.1 million in 2000.

cities.name: Delhi
cities.note: Data for 1991, 2001 and 2011 refer to the metropolitan area that is not restricted to state boundaries (National Capital Territory). Contiguous suburban cities and towns, such as Faridabad, Gurgaon, and Ghaziabad are included in Dehli. The capital is New Delhi. The official estimates for New Delhi and Delhi Urban Agglomeration were 257,803 and 16,349,831 in the year 2011, respectively.
